source.description: A giant sand-yellow cobra with a flared patterned hood, reared upright on its coiled body, swaying slowly side to side, forked tongue flicking out. Seamless loop.

The giant sand-yellow cobra with flared hood attacks — it draws its head back coiling tension, then strikes forward toward the camera with bared fangs, then recoils back into its upright swaying posture.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
